eval.name: Validate all 10000 legal approval codes and the strict negative cases

result.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
try:
    path = Path('/tmp/form/app/validator.py')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('approval_validator', path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    check = getattr(module, 'is_approval_code', None)
    good = (f'APP-{value:04d}' for value in range(10000))
    bad = [None, True, False, 1234, 12.34, b'APP-1234', '', 'APP-', 'APP-00000', 'APP-123', 'APP-12A4',
           'app-1234', 'App-1234', ' APP-1234', 'APP-1234 ', 'XAPP-1234', 'APP-1234X',
           'APP-１２３４', 'APP-١٢٣٤', 'APP-１２34', 'APP-0000\n', 'ＡＰＰ-1234']
    ok = callable(check) and all(check(value) is True for value in good)
    ok = ok and all(check(value) is False for value in bad)
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY

eval.name: Rerun the supplied tests and require test_output.txt to equal their stdout

result.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
def normalized_lines(value):
    return [line.strip() for line in value.splitlines() if line.strip()]
try:
    completed = subprocess.run(['python3', 'validator_tests.py'], cwd='/tmp/form/app', capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False)
    stdout_lines = normalized_lines(completed.stdout)
    saved_lines = normalized_lines(Path('/tmp/form/app/test_output.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    ok = completed.returncode == 0 and stdout_lines == ['12 passed'] and saved_lines == stdout_lines
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY
